mapper.sql: id, system_code, ebank_serial_number, claim_amount, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag, client_code, contract_code, currency_type, order_id, business_date, org_id, org_name, scene_code, scene_name, batch_no, operation_type, non_confirm_second_detail_id, process_status, remark, new_ebank_serial_number, income_ym_old, is_cross_org, voucher_ids
mapper.select: select cs.client_code, cs.bank_amount, cd.claim_amount from ( select cs.client_code , coalesce(sum(cs.bank_amount), 0) bank_amount from eg_non_confirm_collection_sum cs where cs.del_flag = '0' and cs.client_code =#{params.clientCode} group by cs.client_code ) cs inner join ( select cs.client_code , coalesce(sum(crr.claim_amount), 0) claim_amount from eg_non_confirm_collection_sum cs left join eg_business_claim_repayment_record crr on crr.ebank_serial_number = ANY(STRING_TO_ARRAY(cs.ebank_serial_number , ',')) and crr.del_flag ='0' and crr.process_status in ('3','4') where cs.del_flag ='0' and cs.client_code =#{params.clientCode} group by cs.client_code ) cd on cs.client_code = cd.client_code

select sum(claim_amount) claim_amount, contract_code from ( select a.claim_amount , a.contract_code from eg_business_claim_repayment_record a inner join eg_non_confirm_collection_sum ccs on a.ebank_serial_number = ANY(STRING_TO_ARRAY(ccs.ebank_serial_number, ',')) and ccs.del_flag ='0' and ccs.business_date > #{params.businessDate} where a.operation_type !='BUSINESS_AUTO_CLAIM' and a.contract_code = #{params.contractCode} union all select a.claim_amount , a.contract_code from eg_business_claim_repayment_record a where a.operation_type ='BUSINESS_AUTO_CLAIM' and a.business_date > #{params.businessDate} and a.contract_code = #{params.contractCode} ) t group by contract_code
